sloka: ददर्शालंकृतो राजा प्रजापतिरिव प्रजाः ।अथोपविष्टे नृपतौ तस्मिन् परबलार्दने ॥२-१-४८॥
transliteration: dadarśālaṁkṛto rājā prajāpatiriva prajāḥ ।athopaviṣṭe nṛpatau tasmin parabalārdane ॥2-1-48॥

translations.english: After the king (Dasaratha) who was a tormenter of enemy forces was seated, the rest of the kings beloved of their subjects entered (the assembly hall).
